requirement:
调整通知服务和订单管理的数据处理逻辑。
通知服务发送消息时数据格式有误，导致订单服务接收失败。
需要修正通知和订单服务之间的数据格式约定。

details.name: ts-order-service
details.rationale: The requirement explicitly mentions order service receiving notifications, so it must align with the corrected data format.

details.name: ts-order-other-service
details.rationale: This service also handles orders and may consume notifications, so it could be affected by the format change.

details.name: ts-preserve-other-service
details.rationale: Similar to preserve-service, it may send notifications and require format alignment.

details.name: ts-preserve-service
details.rationale: Preserve service likely triggers notifications and may need to adapt to the corrected format.

details.name: ts-cancel-service
details.rationale: Cancellation flows often send notifications, so it may need to match the new format.

details.name: ts-rebook-service
details.rationale: Rebooking operations may involve notifications and could be impacted by the format change.

details.name: ts-admin-order-service
details.rationale: Admin order service may view or process notifications, but less likely to be directly affected.
